name: VersaCarte

about.label: About us
about.title: A product studio built for global scale
about.body: VersaCarte is a remote-first engineering studio that ships mobile applications, web platforms and connected systems for clients across continents. We combine electrical systems thinking with full-stack development and we document every deliverable so your team can own it long after launch.
about.mission: Our mission is simple: help ambitious businesses turn complex ideas into reliable software that works in the real world, whether that means a consumer app in London, an IoT dashboard in Singapore or an internal portal for a growing team in São Paulo.
values: End to end delivery from firmware and APIs to polished mobile UI
Documented architecture you can audit, extend and hand off
Global perspective with support for local payments, languages and connectivity

services.label: Services
services.title: Pick what your product needs from the menu

items.title: Mobile applications
items.body: React Native and Expo for iOS and Android, including marketplaces, field tools and consumer apps with Supabase or custom backends.

items.title: Web platforms
items.body: Astro and React sites, dashboards and internal portals with performance, SEO and conversion-focused architecture.

items.title: IoT & embedded
items.body: ESP8266/32 telemetry, ultrasonic sensing and MQTT ingest using the same patterns behind traffic monitoring and tank-level prototypes.

items.title: Cloud & backend
items.body: PostgreSQL, serverless APIs and Cloudflare Pages Functions that keep clients thin and business rules server-side.

items.title: Systems engineering
items.body: SCADA-aware specs, energy monitoring design and BOQ-grade documentation from an electrical engineering background.

why.label: Why VersaCarte
why.title: One team from schematic to App Store review
why.body: Clients get firmware, API and mobile UI under one roof instead of three vendors who hand off blame. We design for real-world conditions including variable connectivity, diverse devices and the payment methods your market expects.
why.imageAlt: Developers reviewing work on large monitors
